purpose: Test one coefficient-free relaxation of failed V114: retain the complete-assignment admitted-interference Pareto certificate but remove the redundant componentwise candidate-interference filter.

mechanism_and_outcome_diagnosis.v114_failures: Spike throughput and both QPR conventions failed; pulse throughput failed by 0.074%; sustained throughput and both QPR conventions passed strongly.
mechanism_and_outcome_diagnosis.v114_supported_effects: Sustained throughput/QPR improved 5.265%/27.158%, and pulse QPR improved 5.604%.
mechanism_and_outcome_diagnosis.overconstraint_evidence: The componentwise gate rejected 616 candidates across 2,872 spike critical-player evaluations, 545 across 2,708 sustained evaluations, and 466 across 7,914 pulse evaluations. Yet V114 also separately required the complete alternative total interference to be nonworse than the anchor total.
mechanism_and_outcome_diagnosis.independent_axis: Remove componentwise interference filtering while retaining the complete-assignment aggregate interference Pareto certificate. No threshold, coefficient, ratio, horizon, cap, scenario label, or result-derived margin is introduced.

frozen_parent_profiles.temporal_and_service_certificate: 50-frame 3/2 causal activation with maximum candidate-to-anchor admitted-work service proxy ratio 9/10

closed_axes.causal_horizon_refitting: 25 and 50 tested in V109; V115 fixes 50
closed_axes.critical_service_ratio_refitting: 9/10 and 4/5 tested in V108; V115 fixes 9/10
closed_axes.arrival_rate_threshold_refitting: 3/2 and 2/1 tested in V107; V115 fixes 3/2
closed_axes.admitted_work_clearance_objective: retained bit-for-bit from V113 and V114

hypothesis.primary: V114's complete replay already certifies that the chosen critical assignment cannot increase total admitted-work interference. Applying the same certificate separately to every provisional player-node choice forbids compensating reallocations and is unnecessarily conservative during transient spikes.
hypothesis.candidate: Use the exact V113 candidate-selection frontier without the per-choice interference rejection. After the deterministic complete critical-player replay, retain V114's requirement that total alternative interference is no greater than total anchor interference, together with every V113 complete certificate.
hypothesis.falsification: The hypothesis fails if the sole candidate does not pass every paired throughput and both QPR gates in all three E3 scenarios on the complete fresh E914-E916 cohort.

allowed: the frozen V109 first-seen request history, 3/2 shock certificate, and 50-frame activation deadline
the immutable raw CPU of every assigned-but-not-resident pending task
the current finite nonnegative RunningTask.left_calc of every resident task regardless of its current gate
the immutable raw CPU of earlier same-window projected functions and the current player
every immutable and current-state V113 locality, resource, routed-score, OCS, welfare, feasibility, and critical-frontier input
forbidden: completion count, throughput, latency, cost, QPR, SLA outcome, or any completed-request aggregate
future arrivals, future completion, future container state, or future child placement
workload scenario, burst label, seed identity, or registered burst interval as a routing input
E899-E913 result-dependent threshold, ratio, horizon, coefficient, cap multiplier, or scenario refitting
confirmation-seed outcomes before a training pass
information_boundary.arrival_and_activation_definition: Bit-for-bit V109 horizon50: 80-frame baseline, 20-frame recent first-seen ReqId history, at least 20 requests in each, exact 3/2 integer comparison, deadline current_frame+49.
information_boundary.admitted_work_definition: Bit-for-bit V113: pending Func.cpu plus every resident RunningTask.left_calc plus earlier same-window projected Func.cpu plus current-player Func.cpu, each counted exactly once in stable order.
information_boundary.interference_definition: Bit-for-bit V114: for current-player immutable work w and node capacity C, sum min(x,w)/C over pending immutable CPU, resident remaining CPU, and earlier same-window projected immutable CPU.
information_boundary.componentwise_interference_filter: disabled; interference is not used to reject or rank an individual candidate node
information_boundary.complete_assignment_certificate: Replay critical players in frozen order and require the alternative total admitted-work proxy to be strictly lower, total interference no greater than the anchor total, and every V113 routed-score, exact-OCS, welfare, resource, locality, and feasibility certificate to pass.
information_boundary.fail_closed: Any missing task/function, non-finite or negative work, invalid capacity/bandwidth, incomplete parent placement, count mismatch, or arithmetic overflow makes the complete certificate unavailable and preserves the anchor assignment.

candidate_mechanism.only_changed_axis: Disable V114's componentwise candidate-interference rejection; retain V114's complete alternative-total interference nonworsening certificate and all V113 logic.
candidate_mechanism.eligible_players_and_certificates: Bit-for-bit V113 candidate choices, followed by V114 aggregate interference certification after the complete deterministic critical-player replay.
candidate_mechanism.reference_policy: Policy-independent offline reference construction remains unchanged.
candidate_mechanism.exact_anchor_invariant: Without sufficient history, an active horizon, complete work snapshots, or the complete admitted-work and interference certificates, dispatch exact V94 for identical current state and candidates.

per_window: all frozen V114 causal-arrival, admitted-work, critical-service, and aggregate-interference fields
an explicit componentwise_gate_enabled=false field and zero componentwise rejection count
performance fields retained but not opened before joint blind audit

selection_rule.throughput_gate_per_scenario: candidate three-seed mean is at least the matching V94 anchor mean and candidate-minus-anchor is nonnegative on at least two of three seeds
selection_rule.qpr_gate_per_scenario_per_convention: candidate three-seed mean is strictly greater than the matching V94 anchor mean and candidate-minus-anchor is strictly positive on at least two of three seeds
selection_rule.E3_winner_requires: the sole candidate passes all three metrics in all three E3 scenarios
selection_rule.absolute_formal_n20_baseline_gates: diagnostic only and never used to select the V115 profile
